6 of 10 members present. Quorum established.

Agenda
Item 1
Ethics and Compliance Program Annual Report

A presentation on the Ethics and Compliance Program Annual Report was given by Johann Cortez, our external advisor from ACPWB. The presentation benchmarked Aspire Talent Group's practices against 36 peers in the Responsible AI Governance sector. The committee directed management to develop an action plan based on the findings.

Item 2
Job Architecture Redesign — Phase 2 Approval

The Job Architecture Redesign — Phase 2 Approval was a review of the company's real estate portfolio. The committee approved a plan to consolidate 36 office locations, resulting in an estimated annual savings of $36M.

Motion

To approve for partnership: RESOLVED, that the Manufacturing Excellence Committee establishes an ad hoc subcommittee to further investigate the Job Architecture Redesign — Phase 2 Approval and report its findings back to the full committee within 90 days.

Moved: Ilaria Chala  •  Seconded: Clifton Solis
Vote: 5 Yea  /  1 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 3
Stock Ownership Guideline Compliance Review

The Stock Ownership Guideline Compliance Review was a review of the company's compliance with the Dodd-Frank Act. The committee reviewed the company's executive compensation practices and confirmed that they were in compliance.

Motion

To table: RESOLVED, that the Manufacturing Excellence Committee approves the formation of a new subsidiary, Aspire Talent Group, to pursue the Stock Ownership Guideline Compliance Review.

Moved: Chinonso Truong  •  Seconded: Ilaria Chala
Vote: 5 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  1 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 4
Customer Advisory Board Feedback Summary

A special session was held to review the Customer Advisory Board Feedback Summary. Aroha Fischer outlined the strategic rationale for the proposal, emphasizing the competitive pressures in the Responsible AI Governance sector. The committee members questioned the financial assumptions and requested additional sensitivity analysis before the next meeting.
